This document outlines the 
equipment maintenance inspection I1, which must be performed every 1500 hours of 
operation. This procedure was applied in ABU QIR Power Plant since 1985 .

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Booster Pump
قم بتنظيف مرشح شفط المضخة المعززة
General cleaning and inspection for cooling water and oil
Connection lines for leakage (tightened if required)
Check packing and change if required
Tighten fit the gland (M-4-Bolts) if required by hand only
Check the pump fixation on the pump foundation

General cleaning and inspection for cooling water and oil

Check packing and change if required
Tighten fit the gland (M-4-Bolts) if required by hand only
Check the pump fixation on the pump foundation

sections.text: Main Pump
Clean the suction filter of the pump

Make sure of the correct packing for the pump and it is not solid 
if the packing is solid packing must be changed by anew of cress-set 11 mm of 
Fortina type.
Make sure correct fixation of the pump on its base plate.

Cleaning and greasing these valves
 * Main delivery valve and its BY-BASS
 * الحد الأدنى من صمام التدفق
 * Injection valve to manual reheating
 * Drainage valve

sections.text: Hydraulic Coupling
General cleaning of the dust on coupling

Check lubrication oil filter (clean it if required) and check 
operating oil for contamination

اضبط المشغل على وضع الحوض المغرفة الأدنى واضغط على 5 جم من الليثيوم. مصابون 
شحم محمل مضاد للاحتكاك في كل حلمة تشحيم من شحم التحكم 
الأجزاء الساطعة والتحقق من التشغيل السلس للتحكم

Check the oil level and increase if required with turbo oil T46. 
in case of too high oil level, check the operation oil for water content or 
change the oil (turbo oil 46)
General cleaning for the gear box
Check alignment of geared variable speed turbo coupling
Check the gearbox fixation on the foundation
